title: Check selected documentation coverage
statement: As a developer configuring change automation, I can check only the documentation coverage areas and scope my team requires so unrelated gaps do not decide the result.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A check evaluates and returns only the requested implementation, stories, personas, design, quality, or health areas, in the order requested.
A check evaluates the whole app by default, a Git comparison when --against is supplied, and only the named feature when --feature is supplied.
For a trustworthy report, a check exits 0 when every requested area is complete and exits 3 when any requested area has a gap; an untrustworthy report does not return a coverage-gap result.
